name: Fellfrost Peak
desc:
A giant snow-sloped mountain to the south of Snezhnograd. At its feet lies a town that mines Prime Ice.

They say that this entire mountain is the property of a Grand Duchess of the Snegurochka named Pavlina, even the settlement that mines the Prime Ice. However, she has secluded herself in her mountain palace and rarely appears in public.

customize.text: A Wedding Invitation from the Snegovik

<color=#ffd680>August 16, 2026</color>
It is said that has it that marriages between a human and a Snegovik are exceedingly rare. Yet recently, rumor has it that a wedding ceremony is about to be held for the most distinguished princess of the Snegurochka, and as it happens, the scattered power of the "Eye of Graeae" also points in that direction... So let's head over and check it out, shall we?

customize.name: Frostfairy Flower
customize.desc: A sacred flower that blooms no matter how harsh the wind and snow. It always radiates a faint, mesmerizing glow that draws the hearts of all who see it.

customize.name: Flockingweed
customize.desc: A peculiar plant once suspected to be a hybrid of plant and animal, though it was later proven to be nothing more than an ordinary plant covered in a coat of animal-like fuzz.

customize.name: Red Beet
customize.desc: A hardy herbaceous plant capable of thriving even in frozen soil. To survive such an unforgiving environment, it develops a thick, succulent root.

customize.name: Glaciafruit
customize.desc: A star-shaped fruit born from Prime Ice that has undergone a peculiar transformation in the permafrost. Once the branch it grows upon is removed, the fruit falls naturally onto the snow.

customize.name: Snowball Flower
customize.desc: A charming flower with a spherical cluster of petals. When snow settles upon it, the entire bloom looks just like a tiny snowball.

customize.name: Rimecurrant
customize.desc: A richly flavored berry that sprouts from frost-rimed, icy branches.

customize.name: Lumifluorite
customize.desc: A strange fluorite formed under the influence of the powers of the Shadow Realm.

customize.name: Vagabond's Cracked Armor
customize.desc:
An ancient piece of Snegovik armor with cracks all over it.
Armor forged in the old days was never built to last this long. The cracks that have appeared over time have merely been masked by the Snegovik's steadily advancing mastery of Prime Ice technology. Like the cracks across this armor's surface, the oath to safeguard and protect reveals its fragility the instant its keeper is gone.

customize.name: Cryo Treasure Compass
customize.desc:
A compass that can be used in Snezhnaya to search for nearby treasure and relevant clues.
Many treasures lie frozen in hidden places across the land of snow. Those who can undo the seals may claim the gifts left within the ice.

customize.name: Eye of Graeae
customize.desc:
A strange mechanism you encountered in an abandoned station. It often appears in the form of a monocle.

It offers many convenient functions, such as recording blueprints for Prime Ice constructs, creating Prime Ice, calling trains.

...Perhaps it was built for the very purpose of providing all these conveniences.

customize.name: Cryoculus
customize.desc: A substance that has accumulated intense Cryo energy. Offer it to the Statue and help reinstate the power it has lost over the years.

customize.name: Snezhnaya Shrine of Depths Key
customize.desc:
A key that can break the seal on the ancient Shrines of Depths scattered around Snezhnaya.
These Shrines of Depths sealed themselves off when the civilization that built them was lost. Keys lost deep within domains are able to break the seals. Or perhaps that, for a moment, these keys help the seals to forget all that they have lost.

customize.name: Shadow Wingdrop
customize.desc: A strange, liquefied substance left behind by a creature born within the Shadow Realm.

customize.name: Remnant Incense Guide - Fellfrost Peak
customize.desc:
Gathering three pieces of the Remnant Incense Guide - Fellfrost Peak allows you to unseal the vault of Shadow Realm at the Fellfrost Peak.
Legend has it that early squads exploring the Shadow Realm would occasionally find themselves unable to retrieve the treasures they discovered. In such cases, they would leave a specific "scent trail" behind. Only by piecing together the incense trail can one track down the locations of these long-lost relics.

customize.name: Radiant Spincrystal 196
customize.desc: This wondrous crystal contains a certain rhythm, like something beautiful woven from delicate silk. These items can be found throughout the mainland or from merchants who collect curios. The tune held within this crystal can be revivified in your Serenitea Pot using either "Euphonium Unbound: Winding" or "Euphonium Unbound: Soaring." The tune contained within this Radiant Spincrystal is a mysterious melody from Snezhnaya.

customize.name: Radiant Spincrystal 197
customize.desc: This wondrous crystal contains a certain rhythm, like something beautiful woven from delicate silk. These items can be found throughout the mainland or from merchants who collect curios. The tune held within this crystal can be revivified in your Serenitea Pot using either "Euphonium Unbound: Winding" or "Euphonium Unbound: Soaring." The tune contained within this Radiant Spincrystal is a mysterious melody from Snezhnaya.

customize.name: Guardian Blade of Drifting Snow
customize.desc:
An ancient Snegovik held in high esteem among her kin.
She once served the legendary Great Snegurochka, whose name was steeped in crimson infamy, and was entrusted with the solemn duty of protecting the Snegovik clan for the rest of her life. It is said that seven were given this charge, but she alone remains. Every succession of the Snegovik sovereign must therefore take place under her watchful eye.
After the current Snegurochka princess ascended to power, she left the clan's manor in the mountains — perhaps because their ideals no longer aligned.

customize.name: Churin
customize.desc: A Domovoy who studied Prime Ice sculpting diligently under Bragin, a Volkodlak master sculptor. However, Bragin's technique placed speed above all else, prioritizing the completion of works in the shortest possible time, and his training mostly focused on physical conditioning and technique. Naturally, Churin's days of hard work as an apprentice did little to cultivate any artistic sensibility, but he soon discovered that he had become the best fighter among all the apprentices...

customize.name: Glaciomancer
customize.desc:
A Snegovik born of love amid the snow and ice.
Female Snegovik are known as Snegurochka, and most are born as mages capable of freely wielding the power of ice and snow. It's said that when Snegovik were first created, their souls were incomplete, and only by falling in love with humans could they make themselves whole.
Yet once a Snegovik has attained wholeness, does it still need love? Perhaps not.
Maybe this is why so many stories of love between Snegovik and human end in tragedy.

customize.name: Glacial Warden
customize.desc:
A Snegovik born of love amid the snow and ice.
Male Snegovik are natural-born knights, and most are born able to freely forge weapons from ice and snow.
Legend tells that during the Belyi Tsar's campaign against the dark tide, a Snegovik serving as his guard unleashed a power that didn't belong to his kind, transforming into a towering giant.
Though his final fate remains unknown, one who violated such a taboo surely could not have met with a happy end.

customize.name: Winged Halberd-Knight
customize.desc:
A winged Vila capable of flight.
Records show that in the century after the Tsaritsa ascended the throne, the Vila went through many turbulent periods. Among them were fae who launched small-scale rebellions out of dissatisfaction with the Tsaritsa's policies toward the fae nobility.
The rebellions were soon suppressed, but the fact that their leaders were descendants of the old Vila nobility once led to a major split within the Vila people.

customize.name: Winged Soarer Knight
customize.desc:
A winged Vila capable of flight.
It's said that the Vila were among the fae clans that followed the Belyi Tsar from the very beginning of his campaign to unify the frozen lands. Their ability to take brief flight gives them exceptional mobility, allowing them to scout enemy formations and carry out long-distance raids with ease.
Most members of the Druzhna, the personal guard founded during the Belyi Tsar reign, were Vila.

customize.name: Chimeric Armored Beast
customize.desc:
A product of bio-alchemy that was once widespread across the frozen lands, an aberrant chimeric monster.
If a four-legged beast were given a carapace and charging horn like those of an Onikabuto, it might well become a shock force capable of breaking through enemy formations.
In theory, man-made monsters designed around a single function rarely survive in the wild. Once they lose the place or purpose for which they were made, most perish for having defied the laws of nature. Clearly, however, the Armored Beast is not one of them.
Today, on the frozen lands of Snezhnaya, Armored Beasts can often be seen hunting in packs.

customize.name: Chimeric Burrowbeast
customize.desc:
A product of bio-alchemy that was once widespread across the frozen lands, an aberrant chimeric monster.
If a monster that burrows and moves through earth and snow were granted vision that could see all within the shadows, could it become an even stronger predator?
The experiment proved astonishingly successful. These Burrowbeasts move beneath the surface at night, digging traps in the dark or hiding in the shadows to hunt.
According to a report in Vestnik, a worker living in Svetloledovka once saw a giant Burrowbeast nearly as tall as two people... though that is probably nothing more than a wild rumor.

customize.name: Chimeric Winged Elephant
customize.desc:
A product of bio-alchemy that was once widespread across the frozen lands, an aberrant chimeric monster.
A short-legged elephant with wings could likely migrate without being restricted by terrain, and would also be able to reach fruit growing in higher places.
For that purpose alone, its creator brought such a beast into being. Later, during the war against the dark tide, Chimeric Winged Elephants worked alongside the Vila in intelligence and communications, ensuring that the Belyi Tsar's commands could pass smoothly and swiftly as his army advanced.

customize.name: Chimeric Horned Bear
customize.desc:
A product of bio-alchemy, a man-made monster with an exceptionally unusual formation.
A man-made monster not formed according to its creator's design, but through the spontaneous assembly of life segments. As a result, it came to possess certain wondrous traits, including the ability to freely wield elemental power.
Even if life is broken down until almost nothing remains but segments, could some will or power still guide them to grow according to a mysterious plan?
Perhaps no one knows the answer to that by now.

customize.name: Pavlina
customize.desc: Grand Duchess of the Snegurochka from the House of Hesperides.

customize.name: Ikhor
customize.desc: A fragment of the Proto-Man's power, for which the Grand Duchess of the Snegurochka, Pavlina, created a body out of the Primal Ice. The body was destroyed by Pavlina in an attempt to imbue Snegovik with a soul.

customize.name: Aksinya
customize.desc: The leading researcher of Hvergelmir, who created the Eye of Graeae and worked on the creation of the Primordial Human.

customize.name: Specialized Frag Crystals within the Shadow Realm
Shadow Realm Barrier & Shadow Realm Vault
About the Resonant Pillars at the Tidesong Cavern...

galleryCharacter.key: A Lonely Mansion Against the Whiteout

imgDesc.text: A sealed estate that once belonged to the illustrious Grand Duchess of the Snegoviks. Within the silent, frozen walls of that mountain estate, whose deepest longings and dark secrets remain entombed?
Rumor has it that following any endlessly rolling snowball across the snowfields will bring a traveler directly to this place.
Tides lap gently against the cliffs, keeping time with the singer's soft humming. In this vast, solitary expanse, perhaps only the waves and the haunting echoes can bring her a rare moment of peace.
